drivers.name: AudioSynth
drivers.description: Software audio synthesizer. Plays tones, musical notes, and short melodies — useful for lab-side audible notifications, robot/CNC feedback tones, and experiment-complete bell sounds. Streams Opus-encoded audio to every connected dashboard by default; can also (or instead) play locally via NAudio on Windows hosts. Four waveforms, ADSR envelopes, additive harmonics, and presets (beep / bell / pluck / pad / marimba).
drivers.changelog:
## 1.4.1

### Internal

- Streaming path moved off Concentus and onto the new SDK
  `AudioStreamEmitter` API. The driver now hands the host a pre-rendered
  float buffer per note; the host owns Opus encoding, framing, real-time
  pacing, and stop-frame emission. The wire format is unchanged and
  Concentus no longer ships in the AudioSynth `.muxdriver` package —
  it lives once in MuxitServer alongside the central
  `AudioStreamEncoder`.

### Notes

- No driver-author-visible behavior change. Existing connector configs
  and scripts continue to work without modification.

drivers.name: Midi
drivers.description: Advanced MIDI driver — live input/output with any USB or virtual MIDI device, per-channel filtering, pass-through, internal 24-PPQN clock with transport control, Standard MIDI File (SMF) playback and recording, panic/all-notes-off, and a learn helper for mapping physical controls. Streams incoming events as JSON for scripts and dashboards.
drivers.changelog:
# Changelog

## 0.1.2

### Features

- On-demand `Details` documentation layer surfaced to the AI prompt and
  editor hover.

## 0.1.1

Manifest polish — no functional changes.

## 0.1.0

Initial release. Live MIDI input/output over any USB or virtual MIDI
device, per-channel filtering and pass-through, internal 24-PPQN clock
with transport control, Standard MIDI File (SMF) playback and recording,
panic / all-notes-off, and a learn helper for mapping physical controls.
Incoming events stream as JSON for scripts and dashboards.

drivers.name: Scpi
drivers.description: Generic SCPI instrument driver — works with any SCPI-compliant device (oscilloscopes, multimeters, function generators, power supplies, spectrum analyzers) over TCP/IP (LXI, raw socket port 5025), Serial (RS-232/USB-to-serial), or USBTMC (direct USB-B). Provides raw query/write access, configurable timeouts, init command sequences, and auto-connect with *IDN? identity query.
drivers.changelog:
# Changelog

## 1.2.0

### Features

- Declarative SCPI schema: connectors can describe properties and
  methods with `config.scpi: { properties, methods }` entries
  (`voltage: { cmd: "VOLT", type: "float", unit: "V" }`) and the driver
  synthesises get/set/dispatch. Hand-written overrides still win so
  vendor quirks stay expressible.
- On-demand `Details` documentation layer surfaced to the AI prompt and
  editor hover.

## 1.1.2

### Bug Fixes

- Mirror TX/RX to stdout when `config.debug === true` so transport-level
  traffic is captured in server logs alongside the driver's structured
  `scpi` stream.

## 1.1.1

Internal bump for version-verification testing — no user-facing changes.

## 1.1.0

### Bug Fixes

- Stale-response framing fix after reconfigure / timeout: the driver now
  drains the transport on re-connect, honours a configurable `settleMs`
  before the first query, and supports an explicit `resync()` action for
  scripts that need to force a clean slate.

## 1.0.0

Initial release. Generic SCPI driver over TCP/IP (LXI, raw socket :5025)
and Serial (RS-232/USB). Raw query/write access, configurable timeouts,
init command sequences, and auto-connect with `*IDN?` identity query.

drivers.name: SerialProbe
drivers.description: AI-assisted serial protocol reverse-engineering: captures traffic in labelled windows, detects framing and checksums locally, correlates stimulus/response, and exports a working connector config.
